definitions.content:
Only instruments of classes I and II may be fitted with an auxiliary indicating device, which shall be:

- a device with a rider;

- a device for interpolation of reading;

- a complementary displaying device (see Figure 4); or

- an indicating device with a differentiated scale division (see Figure 5).

These devices are permitted only to the right of the decimal sign.

A multi-interval instrument shall not be fitted with an auxiliary indicating device.

notes.content:
Extended displaying devices (see T.2.6 and 4.4.3) are not regarded as auxiliary indicating devices.
